title.zh: 宣布每年 6 月 19 日为北萨马省特别非工作假日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring June 19 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Northern Samar to Commemorate its Foundation Day
title.orig: An Act Declaring June 19 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Northern Samar to Commemorate its Foundation Day
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 19 tháng 6 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Tỉnh Northern Samar, nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 19 มิถุนายนของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในจังหวัด Northern Samar เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 19 Juni setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Provinsi Northern Samar, dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 19 Jun setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Wilayah Northern Samar, sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9414_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: June 19 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Province of Northern Samar to commemorate its foundation day.
This Act sha1l take effect immediately upon its approval.
